official.deadline_note: The announcement states a single application deadline of 29/08/2026 for the 2026/2027 cycle; no separate institutional or programme deadline is published, and candidates apply only through HEC Rwanda.
official.application_cycle: 2026/2027 academic year; call published 26 August 2026, window closed 29 August 2026
official.status_note: The 2026/2027 call was published on 26 August 2026 with a 29 August 2026 application deadline, so that window has closed. The HEC scholarships listing shows no newer Morocco call, so the next round is expected around the same late-August window.
eligibility: Diploma (Technical and Vocational) candidates must have completed a Technical Secondary School (TSS) STEM-related combination in the 2024/2025 school year and obtained at least 70% in the 2025 national examination
Bachelor's (General Education) candidates must have completed secondary studies in a STEM-related combination in the 2024/2025 school year and obtained at least 70% in the 2025 national examination
Master's and PhD candidates must have obtained 14/20 (2nd Class Upper Division) or equivalent in the previous level completed
requirements: Application letter addressed to the Director General of HEC indicating the programme the candidate wishes to study
Copy of national ID or valid passport
Copy of transcript of the last high school year (Diploma and Bachelor candidates) or of the previous university level (Master's and PhD candidates)
Copy of certificate or degree of the most recently completed level of studies
documents: Application letter addressed to the Director General of HEC naming the intended programme
Copy of ID or valid passport
Transcript of the last high school year (Diploma and Bachelor applicants)
Transcript of the previous university level (Master's and PhD applicants)
Certificate or degree of the most recently completed level of studies
application_method: Submit a complete application file online via https://hecmis.hec.gov.rw/
After submission through the HEC system, fill in the online form linked from the announcement
official.application_route: Apply online through HEC MIS at hecmis.hec.gov.rw, then complete the additional online form published with the call; candidates apply to HEC Rwanda, not directly to Moroccan institutions.
official.citizenship_residency: Scholarships offered by the Kingdom of Morocco to the Government of Rwanda; candidates apply through Rwanda's Higher Education Council (HEC)
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Diploma (Technical and Vocational) and Bachelor's (General Education) applicants must come from STEM-related combinations; no field restriction is published for Master's and PhD applicants
official.description: The Kingdom of Morocco has offered the Government of Rwanda scholarships at Diploma, Bachelor's, Master's and PhD level commencing in academic year 2026/2027, taught in French at Moroccan public training institutions and universities. Applications are handled by Rwanda's Higher Education Council and submitted online through HEC MIS, followed by an additional online form published with the call. The call was published on 26 August 2026 with an application deadline of 29 August 2026.
official.program_type: Bilateral government scholarship (Kingdom of Morocco - Government of Rwanda)

verification.notes: Downloaded and read the full official HEC Rwanda call PDF (published 26/08/2026), extracted its embedded application links (HEC MIS and the follow-up online form), and checked the HEC scholarships listing for any newer Morocco call (none found). The announcement defines levels, eligibility, required documents and the 29/08/2026 deadline but publishes no monetary value or coverage terms; the Moroccan awarding side (AMCI) official pages carry only general context and no figures for this call, so all funding fields remain unconfirmed.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a short-window bilateral call: the 2026/2027 round opened 26 August 2026 and closed 29 August 2026, so the realistic target is the next round expected in the same late-August window. Everything runs through Rwanda's Higher Education Council - candidates submit their file on HEC MIS and then complete the extra online form linked in the announcement, and the published announcement states no money terms at all, so any assumption about tuition, stipend or travel support must wait for an award letter or direct confirmation from HEC. Studies are taught in French at Moroccan public institutions, so comfortable academic French matters more than any English test here.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Rwandan students straight out of a STEM secondary/TSS track or holding a strong first degree who want study in French at a Moroccan public institution and can move fast inside a days-long application window.
application_readiness_checklist: Watch the HEC scholarships page (hec.gov.rw/updates/scholarships) from mid-August each year, since this call historically appears with a window of only a few days
Have a HEC MIS account ready at hecmis.hec.gov.rw before the call opens, since first-time account setup inside a 3-day window is a common time sink

Prepare the application letter addressed to the Director General of HEC naming the exact programme you want, and keep scans of your ID/passport, transcripts and latest certificate in one folder for upload
Diarise the second step: the online form linked in the announcement must be completed after the HEC MIS submission, and only a completed pair of submissions counts

Confirm your marks against the published thresholds before applying: 70%+ in the 2025 national examination for Diploma/Bachelor tracks, or 14/20 (2nd Class Upper Division) or equivalent for Master's/PhD
common_rejection_risks: Applying directly to a Moroccan university or to the Moroccan side instead of going through HEC Rwanda, which is the only route the call recognises
A non-STEM secondary or TSS combination at Diploma/Bachelor level, or national examination marks below the 70% threshold
Master's/PhD applicants whose division falls short of 14/20 (2nd Class Upper Division) or equivalent
Submitting on HEC MIS but never completing the follow-up online form, leaving the application incomplete
Missing the window entirely because the call is published and closed within days
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Unknown and must be assumed conservatively: the call publishes no coverage terms, so budget for international travel to Morocco, installation costs, health cover and personal living expenses until the scholarship's actual benefits are confirmed.
document_audit: Transcripts must match the level applied for: last high school year for Diploma/Bachelor, previous university level for Master's/PhD - sending the wrong transcript is the easiest way to make a file look incomplete
The application letter is addressed to the Director General of HEC and must state the programme you wish to study; a generic letter without the named programme does not meet the published wording
Copies must be of the most recently completed level's certificate/degree, not an earlier qualification
The ID or passport copy must be clearly legible; the announcement accepts either document
alerts: Timing trap: the 2026/2027 window opened 26 August 2026 and closed 29 August 2026 - there was no grace period, so treat the call as effectively a three-day sprint
Language of instruction is French; no English test is published, but non-francophone candidates should assess their level against university study in French
No monetary value is published anywhere in the official call, so do not rely on aggregator figures for this scheme
As of the verification date the HEC scholarships page lists no newer Morocco call, so anything dated after 29 August 2026 for the 2026/2027 intake is closed
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Assemble the four-document file, upload it through HEC MIS, then complete the additional online form linked in the announcement; HEC Rwanda compiles and forwards applications under the Morocco-Rwanda bilateral scheme.
